body.zh-Hant: 尼古拉二世1868年5月生於皇村，是皇儲亞歷山大·亞歷山德羅維奇與丹麥出身的瑪麗亞·費奧多羅芙娜的長子。1894年亞歷山大三世去世，他繼位為皇帝，並在父親去世後一個月內成婚。
body.en: Nicholas II was born at Tsarskoe Selo in May 1868, the first child of the heir Alexander Alexandrovich and the Danish-born Maria Fedorovna. Alexander III died in 1894 and Nicholas became emperor; he married within a month of his father's death.

body.zh-Hant: 1904年日本進攻俄國，俄軍1904年12月交出旅順；1905年1月9日聖彼得堡的和平示威遭軍隊開火，死者逾千人，各地罷工與農民騷動隨之而起。同年10月，尼古拉在讓步中同意設立民選的杜馬。
body.en: Japan attacked Russia in 1904 and the army surrendered Port Arthur in December 1904. On 9 January 1905 troops fired on a peaceful demonstration in St Petersburg, killing more than a thousand people, and strikes and peasant unrest followed. In October Nicholas conceded an elected legislature, the Duma.

heading.en: Stolypin and the aftermath of the Duma

body.zh-Hant: 1906年4月起，彼得·斯托雷平出任內政大臣，同年夏天升任總理，推行鎮壓與改革並行的政策。但尼古拉不認為需要改革，局勢平靜後即想回到1905年以前的狀態；1913年羅曼諾夫王朝三百週年慶典也顯示他的這種想法。
body.en: In April 1906 Peter Stolypin became minister of the interior and in the summer of 1906 was elevated to prime minister, pursuing repression combined with reform. Nicholas did not agree that reform was needed and, once calm returned, wanted to return to the pre-1905 situation; the 1913 Romanov tercentenary celebrations illustrated this view.

heading.en: The World War and supreme command

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰初期俄軍表現不佳，尼古拉親自擔任軍隊總司令，1915年8月以後多半時間待在大本營，遠離彼得格勒。皇后因此更依賴拉斯普廷，並常把他對人事的看法轉告皇帝。
body.en: After the Russian armies performed badly early in the war, Nicholas took direct charge as commander-in-chief and after August 1915 spent most of his time at headquarters away from Petrograd. The empress consequently grew more reliant on Rasputin and passed on his views on appointments.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年2月底彼得格勒爆發示威與暴動，尼古拉當時在莫吉廖夫大本營，搭火車返回首都的嘗試受阻。他於1917年3月退位（日期兩來源不同：Encyclopedia.com 條目作3月2日，美國國會圖書館指南作3月15日）：先讓位予其子，在醫生說阿列克謝不適任後改讓位予其弟米哈伊爾，米哈伊爾拒絕，羅曼諾夫王朝告終。他被新成立的臨時政府拘禁，1918年4月底與家人被移往葉卡捷琳堡，同年7月17日清晨全家遭槍決。
body.en: Demonstrations and riots broke out in Petrograd at the end of February 1917 while Nicholas was at headquarters in Mogilev, and his attempt to return to the capital by train was thwarted. He abdicated in March 1917 (the day differs between sources: 2 March in the Encyclopedia.com entry, 15 March in the Library of Congress guide). He first gave up the throne in favour of his son, then, after medical advice that Alexei was unfit, offered it to his brother Mikhail; when Mikhail refused, the Romanov dynasty came to an end. He was placed under arrest by the new Provisional Government; at the end of April 1918 he and his family were moved to Yekaterinburg, where they were all shot early on 17 July 1918.

body.zh-Hant: 裕仁1901年4月29日生，是嘉仁親王（後來的大正天皇）的長子，1908年4月入學習院。1912年9月9日立為皇太子；1918年2月4日與良子女王訂婚，1924年1月26日成婚。1921年3月他出訪歐洲，是日本皇太子首次出國；同年11月25日回國後不久，因父親精神狀況日益惡化，被任命為父親的攝政。
body.en: Hirohito was born on 29 April 1901, first son of Crown Prince Yoshihito (later the Taisho emperor), and entered the Gakushuin in April 1908. He was made heir apparent on 9 September 1912, was engaged to Princess Nagako on 4 February 1918 and married her on 26 January 1924. In March 1921 he toured Europe, the first Japanese crown prince to go abroad, and on 25 November 1921, shortly after his return, he was appointed regent for his father, who had begun to show increasing signs of mental derangement.

body.en: Hirohito acceded to the throne on 25 December 1926 and took the reign name Showa, 'Enlightened Peace'. His formal enthronement took place in accordance with ancient rituals in November 1928.

heading.en: The Manchurian incident and military unrest

body.zh-Hant: 即位後不久，日本軍官策劃暗殺滿洲軍閥張作霖；年輕的天皇為此震怒，促請田中義一首相查明並懲處責任者。1931年9月部分軍人自行策動佔領滿洲南部，他同樣憤慨。1936年2月26日軍人叛亂時，他要求迅速鎮壓並懲處叛亂士兵與刺客。該條目稱他自視為受1889年憲法約束的君主、國家機關之一，而非個人專制者。
body.en: Shortly after his accession, Japanese army officers arranged the assassination of the Manchurian warlord Chang Tso-lin; the young emperor was angered and urged Premier Giichi Tanaka to find and punish the culprits. He was equally indignant in September 1931, when army elements engineered the occupation of southern Manchuria on their own initiative. During the military insurrection of 26 February 1936 he urged swift suppression and punishment of the mutineers and assassins. The entry says he saw himself as an organ of state bound by the constitution of 1889 rather than a personal autocrat.

body.zh-Hant: 1937年7月中日開戰；該條目稱天皇在1930年代後期聽從宮中顧問建議，不直接介入政治，對日益好戰的政府所決定的政策一概同意。1941年9月6日決定對美開戰時，他的反對僅止於引用祖父的一首詩暗示和平願望。1945年8月9日的御前會議上他表明主張向盟國投降，同年9月日本正式投降。
body.en: Hostilities with China broke out in July 1937. The entry says that in the late 1930s he followed his palace advisers' counsel to stay aloof from direct intervention in politics and consented to whatever policies the increasingly belligerent governments decided. When the final decision on war with the United States was made on 6 September 1941, his opposition was confined to an oblique reference to one of his grandfather's poems, which expressed hope for peace. At an imperial conference on 9 August 1945 he indicated his opinion in favour of surrender, and Japan formally surrendered in September 1945.

body.zh-Hant: 投降後外界曾揣測天皇是否會被當作戰犯處置，但包括麥克阿瑟在內的美方認為讓他留任有利於穩定與改革。1946年1月1日他發佈詔書，否認自己是太陽女神後裔的神聖君主。他於1989年1月7日去世，享年87歲。
body.en: After the surrender there was speculation that the emperor would be punished as a war criminal, but American authorities including MacArthur judged that leaving him in place better served stability and reform. On 1 January 1946 he issued a rescript denying his divinity as a descendant of the sun-goddess. He died on 7 January 1989 at the age of 87.

body.en: Irigoyen was born on 12 July 1852 into a middle-class family in Buenos Aires. heading.en: Leader of the Radical Civic Union

body.zh-Hant: 1890年伊里戈延加入公民聯盟；1891年該黨分裂，他是激進公民聯盟（UCR）的創黨人之一，後來成功從阿萊姆手中奪得黨的主導權，1898年時已是公認的激進派領袖。激進公民聯盟十五年間拒絕以選舉政黨身分參選，抱持棄權策略直到1912年。
body.en: Irigoyen joined the Unión Cívica in 1890; when the party split in 1891 he was one of the founders of the Unión Cívica Radical (UCR), and he later worked successfully to wrest control of it from Alem, being the acknowledged leader of radicalism by 1898. For fifteen years the UCR refused to run as an electoral party, pursuing a strategy of abstention from polls until 1912.

body.zh-Hant: 1916年他當選總統，總統府的傳記稱他為首位經普選產生的總統，任期分為1916–1922與1928–1930兩段。Encyclopedia.com 條目說第一任期充滿矛盾：他干預省級選舉；一戰期間堅持中立；教育與社會保障受重視；並設計新型公營企業開發國家油田。1921年的肉品加工廠罷工與騷亂中，政府授權對罷工者使用暴力。
body.en: He won the presidency in 1916; the presidential office's biography calls him the first president elected by popular vote, serving in two periods, 1916–1922 and 1928–1930. The Encyclopedia.com entry says the first term was marked by contradiction: he intervened in provincial elections; he stuck to neutrality through the First World War; education and social security were prioritised; and he devised a new model of public corporation to exploit national oil fields. During the meat-packing strikes and riots of 1921 government-authorised violence was used against strikers.

heading.en: Second presidency, the 1930 coup and death

body.zh-Hant: 1928年他再度當選總統；第二任期他對美國總統胡佛在中美洲與加勒比的擴張政策採取強硬立場，但他對軍隊事務的干預變得令人無法容忍，為1930年政變鋪路；大蕭條又使國家失去施予恩庇的能力，侵蝕了激進黨的民眾基礎。1930年9月6日，他被退役將軍烏里武魯推翻。他於1933年7月3日在布宜諾斯艾利斯去世。
body.en: He won a second term as president in 1928, in which he stood up to US President Hoover's expansionist policies in Central America and the Caribbean; his meddling in military matters became intolerable and helped lay the groundwork for the 1930 coup, while the Great Depression destroyed the state's ability to grant patronage and undermined the UCR's popular base. On 6 September 1930 he was deposed by retired General José Félix Uriburu. He died on 3 July 1933 in Buenos Aires.
